transcript.note: Round 1 — 90 classified nodes, 117 segments, laid out straight off the working map's gx/gy. Method: since criterion 3 (no east/west or north/south flip between ANY pair, connected or not) is the one thing nothing here measures for me, I made it structurally impossible instead of checking it after the fact — col is a hand-built monotone step function of gx and row a monotone step function of (1000-gy), so no pair can flip on either axis, and equal col/row is the only degeneracy. All the design freedom then goes into WHERE the band boundaries sit, which is what buys H/V. Interchanges first (criterion 1): the gx 705-723 band makes 明德-85-民權西路-中山-台北車站-中正紀念堂-古亭-88 one straight column (the red north-south spine, 7 verticals), gx 758-784 makes 南京復興-忠孝復興-大安 / 大坪林-七張-新店 one column (the eastern Bannan/Wenhu/Xindian trunk, 5), gx 547-590 stacks 海山-板橋-87-頭前庄-新北產業園區 plus the 淡水 and 淡海 branches (6), gx 631-649 and 684-693 and 742-749 take the rest. Then rows: gy 523-538 gives 長庚醫院-新北產業園區 / 89-大橋頭-民權西路-行天宮 one line, gy 553-567 gives 84-三重 and 中山-松江南京-南京復興, gy 601-612 gives 忠孝新生-忠孝復興-永春, gy 621-640 gives 中正紀念堂-東門-大安-廣慈, gy 754-787 gives 莒光-中和-景安 and 動物園-萬芳醫院, gy 707-736 gives 75-81-永和永平國小. Band positions are proportional to geography (col ~ gx/10, row ~ (1000-gy)/10) rather than rank-spread, so stations sit within about 1-2% of their true relative position. Two places needed care because this chain has no skeleton contraction: 大坪林 now connects straight to 古亭 (no 萬隆 in between) and 79 straight to 新店溪 (no intermediate river node), and both chords cut across the 新店溪 in the real geography. The 大坪林-古亭 chord crossed the 86-新店溪 river segment in my first pass, so I pulled 新店溪(749,747) from row 26 up to row 24 — still strictly between 永和永平國小 (row 28) and 中和 (row 23), so the monotone order is intact, and it puts the river segment clear of the chord. Result: 68 of 117 H/V with no crossings, no vertex-on-line and no shared cells, on a 100x101 grid.
